feedback.problem:
Given that
$C=[\begin{aligned}4 & 6 & 2 \\ 3 & 6 & 4 \\ 2 & 3 & 1\end{aligned}]$,
which of the following elementary row operations makes ${a}_{22}=0?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Of the given options, we consider the row operation 

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{3}.
$$

Applying the above row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 6 & 2 \\ 3 & 6 & 4 \\ 2 & 3 & 1\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-2)\cdot {R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}4 & 6 & 2 \\ -1 & 0 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{3}.
$$
